findings.label: Unscripted concurrency race
findings.detail: The xmin two-writer collision was not driven live. The token mapping on StockItem, the no-op model-snapshot migration, and the UseMessageRetry(Handle<DbUpdateConcurrencyException>, Immediate(5)) on the Inventory endpoint are all present and model-verified, and the gate (token present + exception handled by retry) is satisfied. This is a documented evidence gap, not a code gap; a forced two-writer script would close it fully.
